main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: In venias enim quibus omnia & veterum Scepti-ci.

Qui enim, quod ex rationis lege & experimentorum suffragiis decidendum sibi solis vendicant, et a se solis exspectari debere sibi persuadent, digni certe commiseratione sunt: Si enim solos sapere, solosque omnium rerum habere experimenta opinantur: qua mentis ἀρρωσίᾳ[?], & vanissima persuasio est. Ad Hippocratem hos ablego, & è primo eius aphorismo, adversus ἀρρωσίαν hanc, medelam petere iubeo. Ὁ βίος, inquit Senex Cous, βραχύς, ἡ δὲ τέχνη μακρή, ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὀξύς, ἡ δὲ πεῖρα σφαλερή, ἡ δὲ κρίσις χαλεπή.

Alii in contrarium incurrunt, suo quoque iudicio plane diffidentes quibusvis opinionum fluctibus se iactari patiuntur, & postquam diu in utramque partem disputarunt, in neutrum tandem assensu suo inclinant, scepticorum more in medio suspensa relinquentes omnia: quos non doctores, sed dubitatores vere dixeris.
Sunt etiam qui in unius hominis ita iurent verba, & ad κυρίας eius δόξας tam pertinaciter adhaerescant, ut non tantum ab iis dissentire sibi ne-fas

Its exact placement in the text is approximate, so it is attached to the first line of that paragraph. The handwritten annotation at the top right ("Quinam minus / iuste?") is manuscript, not printed, and has been left out. The left margin shows only the cut edge of the neighbouring page and is left out. The opening word "In" of the first paragraph has a large initial I. The paragraph's first lines are only partly visible because the transcription above is abridged for the margin note; the full first paragraph should be checked against the scan: "In venias enim quibus omnia & veterum recentiorum inventa ac dogmata sordeant, quique verum nihil judicent, aut orbi commendent, nisi quod musteum sit, & nudius tertius in ipsorum cerebello natum. Horum certe intolerabilis mihi fastus videtur, & iudicium non usque adeo sanum." This is copied from the printed lines and is not guessed. The Greek of the Hippocratic aphorism and the Greek words "κυρίας" and "δόξας" are read from a small, slightly blurred scan; check their accents. Catchword "fas" at the foot right; signature "C" at the foot centre.
